classification: Assistant read-only review of every displayed fixed/section answer against frozen paragraphs and key; no external-world fact checking, grade overrides or input changes
metric_limits: Direct-gold-span metric is conditioned on original-paragraph containment; false can mean boundary failure despite literal answer presence.
Paragraph containment does not prove relevance: C04 second quote is in correct paragraph but answers neither facet.
Original F04/F05 annotations contain 14/Ten alternatives. Do not modify questions, annotations or outcomes after first answers.
Historic political/economic/colonial-ideology passage claims are evaluated as source contents, not current guidance or scientific endorsement.
Constructed scope controls repeat earlier templates; public data may have model exposure.
